title: Department of Computing & Information Technology
description: This course provides broad coverage of e-commerce systems. It covers the various ecommerce business models and e-commerce payment systems. The course will be delivered using a combination of lectures, eLearning, case studies and various online resources. Assignments will take the form of written examinations, lab examinations, group projects and presentations. ASSESSMENT  (No final written examination)
